name: Pseudoedophrys hilleri
desc: Weevil (Pseudoedophrys hilleri): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pseudoedophrys is a genus of oriental broad-nosed weevils in the beetle family Curculionidae. There is one described species in Pseudoedophrys, P. hilleri.
